solution.summary: [Sample response – sample mode ignores what you typed.] Consolidate the client's reporting onto a single data platform within six weeks, then agree metric definitions once the platform is live. This gives leadership one trusted set of numbers quickly at modest cost.
steps: Select and license a cloud data platform in the first week.
Connect all three source systems to the platform by the end of week three.
Rebuild the board reports on the new platform in weeks four to six.
Agree metric definitions with the department heads once the new reports are live.
Budget $150,000 in total: $90,000 for licenses, $40,000 for integration and $30,000 for report rebuilding.

flaws.quote: Agree metric definitions with the department heads once the new reports are live.
flaws.explanation: Definitions are the root cause of the conflicting numbers; agreeing them after the build means the new platform reproduces the same inconsistencies.
flaws.correction: Agree metric definitions first, before connecting systems or rebuilding reports.

flaws.quote: $90,000 for licenses, $40,000 for integration and $30,000 for report rebuilding
flaws.explanation: The parts add up to $160,000, not the $150,000 total stated.
flaws.correction: Either state a $160,000 budget or reduce one of the components by $10,000.

flaws.quote: Connect all three source systems to the platform by the end of week three.
flaws.explanation: Integrating three systems with conflicting data in two weeks is very unlikely, especially before definitions are agreed.
flaws.correction: Allow six to eight weeks for integration, starting with the system of record for board metrics.

look_for: [Sample] How the work is phased, and what has to happen before what
Whether the budget figures are internally consistent
Whether the timeline is realistic for the work described
Whether the choice of platform fits a mid-sized client

corrected_solution.summary: [Sample] Agree the board's metric definitions first, then consolidate reporting onto a single data platform in phases. This gives leadership one trusted set of numbers without rebuilding the old inconsistencies.
steps: Agree metric definitions with the department heads in the first two weeks.
Select and license a cloud data platform.
Connect the three source systems over six to eight weeks, starting with the system of record for board metrics.
Rebuild the board reports on the new platform using the agreed definitions.
Budget $160,000 in total: $90,000 for licenses, $40,000 for integration and $30,000 for report rebuilding.
